recommendation: Combined extraction and full-body decision is a viable job boundary; default dom_smoothie output is not qualified for production article evidence.
implementation: Isolated native Rust probe linked to current backend preparation/parsers. No application dependency, queue, migration, prompt, reader service, production binary, enrollment or publication changed.
target_flow: One article intake job resolves/fetches/extracts once
Decision spectrum judges the extracted body for each canonical query subject and selects characters
Retain one relevant body and target routes; rejected records retain a processed marker
Character plugins consume the shared body
test_flow: Native HTTP fetch and initial Markdown parse wrote audit receipts; a streaming consumer re-extracted the saved HTML as formatted text and made experimental body-spectrum calls. This is a component pipeline experiment, not a deployed single-job implementation or production queue/daily-edition test.

runtime.host: Mac mini M4, 16GB; existing d1 decision endpoint on Archbox

cohort.source: Same frozen MD5-selected real RSS discovery window used for the October 18 reader load test, rediscovered October 17; fetched October 19. Not a new holdout or a fresh live sweep.
cohort.paired_html: Saved HTTP responses from October 18; excludes refetch drift from this six-article comparison.

batch.usable_story_count: Not established; known boilerplate/recommendation-only false successes are included in 72.
batch.network_caveat: Normal native resolver/domain spacing, concurrency four. Results include Google wrapper resolution and network waits on a different host/date from the browser test; not an extraction-only speedup comparison.

decisions.bank: Three existing v7 topic questions adapted to article evidence, existing cutoffs 55/15/80; production configuration and local v8 relevance-only criteria were not changed.
decisions.accuracy: Unlabeled broad batch; routing counts are not usefulness or accuracy.

reuse.limits: Experimental file retention and offline fan-out only. No new durable production dedup/cache integration, cross-alias dedup, retry/crash fencing or exactly-once external I/O claim.

paired_extraction.review: Reviewed key reporting, attribution, uncertainty and late paragraphs against retained reference. SI paragraph duplication from old custom extraction is absent; all six retain some degree of page furniture, including tracking text on St. Pauli. Not an independent completeness standard.

plugin_replay.limitations: Current task assemblers, model options and evaluate_prepared parsers; no production publication, database commit, full-day aggregation, historical context or automatic retry tested. Broad Insider cases have no canonical co-mention candidates, so structured findings are disabled there.

source_and_output_findings.finding: Yahoo HTTP response has no main story text. Extraction contains headline/caption and recommended stories. Decision admits the caption-only Hawks subject; Journalist abstains. Pacers summary is largely headline-only.
Yahoo main story absent; extractor returns recommendations. Influencer treats those recommendations as story evidence and produces a misleading 76ers reading.
RotoWire extraction returns legal/gambling footer, not the report. Influencer invents mutual departure and emotions. Word floor and spectrum did not protect this case.

Photo caption causes false Jets admission; Journalist abstains. Packers summary swaps Ford/Hargrave injuries and incorrectly extends season-ending absence to both; correct details were present in extracted text.

Historical Nets association causes false admission and an off-target Journalist summary. Insider output changes a curly apostrophe inside its evidence quote and is correctly rejected by exact-containment validation.
Reader retains both teenagers and correct 4-1 Newcastle match; Journalist invents a 5-0 Nottingham Forest result. This is a downstream model error, not missing extraction.

rejected_variant.method: Require exactly one article container, restrict body before Readability
rejected_variant.reason: Blocks Yahoo recommendation and RotoWire footer examples but rejects too much legitimate material; not selected.

remaining: Qualify a fail-closed main-article evidence contract on raw HTTP pages before integrating the reader into the single durable intake job; keep parser guards and measure plugin factual fidelity independently.

verification.batch_accounting: 100 input IDs, all terminal outcomes retained
verification.decision_accounting: 90 expected canonical-subject requests, all responses validated
